tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las/ 'dab chags mgon po rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so//

༄༅// nam mkha' lding gi mtshan nyid bstan pa/ mkha' lding zhes pa rkang pa nas ni dpyi kha dog mthar ser po dpe gcig la de las gong du snang*/ de bzhin du lte ba'i mtshams su kha ba'i mdog ste dkar po dang*/ /mgrin pa'i bar du kha dog dmar po dang sprin nag dang mtshungs pa ni smin ma'i 'khri shing ji srid nyid du ste// de phyir smin mtshams yan chad/ nges par kha dog sna tshogs rdo rje ljang gu gdengs can te klu rigs lnga'i rgyan dang bcas pa de gtsug tor la sogs pa'i 'khor lo lnga la nam mkha'i yi ge la sogs pa nyid lnga yis rgyas btab pa// bsgoms te sngags bzlas na de yi phyag rgyas gdengs can sbrul gyi dug dang 'byung po'i nad la sogs pa 'dug dag kyang nges par 'phrog go/ 182 de sgom pa'i thabs ni /rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma dag la nyi ma'i steng du k+ṣiṃ gi yi ge yongs su gyur ba las/ 'dab chags mgon po kha dog lnga pa ni// klu bcu yi rgyan dang ldan zhing mtha' dag rigs kyi dbang gis 'od zer/ kha dog lnga rnams 'phro ba bsgoms par bya// de nas 'dab chags mgon po'i sngags ni dang po oṃ yig dag dang pa k+ṣiṃ swā hā'i mtha' can te// de ni bye ba phrag gcig bzlas nas sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bcu bya ste/ gdengs can rigs dang bcas pa'i gnyen po 'dab chags mgon po nam mkha' lding bsgrub par bya/ 183 de yi phan yon ni /mkha' lding grub na gdengs can te klu'i dbang po rnams dang gdengs can bdag po'i bu rnams mngag gzhug ste bran nyid du 'gyur/ zhing*/ /rab mchog sa yi steng du 'byung po dang gnod sbyin dang gza' la sogs ba'i gdon rnams dag dang mkha' 'gro ma dang 'jig rten gyi

ma mo rnams// sngags kyis dgug par rab tu 'gyur te gdon gyi tshogs pa mtha' dag dus 'chi bdag gi kyi sos zin pa'i nad pa ji skad brjod par bzhin du byed cing nad las grol ba byed/ do/ /de phyir sems can gyi don gyi slad du dang por mi rnams kyis ni mkha' lding dbang po bsgrub par bya/ 'o/ 184 /zhes bya ba ni bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi sgrub bu ston rin po che'i gsung mchan bcas/ thabs kyi le'u 4 las so// ༈ /'dab chags mgon po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rnams bzhugs so// na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom bzlas bya/ de'i rjes su rang gi lus bsrung bar bya ste/ de yang dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gtsug tor du haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣa/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi sor mo rnams la rim pa bzhin du/ a i ṛ u l̥ bsgom/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas mthe chung gi bar sor mo rnams la/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā bsgom zhing*/ brla g.yon du la/ g.yas su lā/ de bzhin du lte ba'i g.yon g.yas su wa wā/ snying ga'i g.yon g.yas su ra rā/ kha nang gi g.yon g.yas su ya yā/ dbul ba'i g.yon g.yas su ha hā yod par bsgom/ rna ba g.yon par hūm̐/ g.yas su k+ṣūm̐/ de bzhin du mgrin pa g.yon g.yas su h+ya h+yā/ mchan khung g.yon g.yas su hra hrā/ dku g.yon g.yas su hwa hwā/ brla g.yon g.yas su h+la h+lā bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du k+ṣiṃ gi yi ge las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus 'od du zhu yongs su gyur pa las 'dab chags mgon po a ni la rkang pa nas dpyi'i bar ser po/ dpyi nas lte ba'i bar dkar po/ lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar dmar po/ mgrin pa nas smin mtshams kyi bar nag po/ smin mtshams nas gtsug tor gyi bar ljang gu ste/

mdog lnga par bsgom/ de yang klu rigs lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā ste/ de nyid lnga'i rgyas btab par bsgoms nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mchod pas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ mchod pas mchod nas/ dbang bskur bar bsgom/ de nas 'dab chags mgon po'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du k+ṣiṃ gi ye ge la/ oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ swā hās bskor bar dmigs nas/ bzlas pa bye ba phrag gcig bzlas pas/ gdengs can dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ gza' la sogs pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ 'jig rten gyi ma mo rnams ji ltar bsgo ba nyan par 'gyur ro// sbrul gyi sos zin pa la sogs pa'i nad srung bar byed na/ gang du song ba'i srung ma rnams kyis nad pa'i lus la bsrung bar byas nas/ 'dam bu'i byang bu sor nyi shu pa'am rang gi lag mthil la gang du song ba'i klu bcu'i sa bon bkod nas/ nad pa'i snying gar bsnan dug gcod par byed do// nad pa'i dpral bar la/ rkang par ha sgom na dug rengs par byed do// spyi bor wa dang*/ lte bar ra sgom na dug med par byed do// dpral bar ya/ snying gar ra sgom na dug 'pho bar byed do// spyi bor ha dang rkang par la sgom na dug gcod par byed do// dpral bar thig le dkar po sgom na brtan g.yo bcos ma gsum gyi dug kyang med par byed/ dpral bar thig le dmar ser sgom na dug gcod par byed/ nag po sgom na dug 'jig par byed/ thig le ser po sgom na dug rengs par byed/ de rnams bsam gtan gyis bcos pa'o// sman gyis bcos pa ni/ lga/ pi bi ling*/ na le shaṃ ste tsha ba gsum dri chu dang sbyar nas rlung gang du rgyu ba'i ngos kyi snas rngubs na dug med par byed/

yang na shing mgo la tshil btags nas lce'u chung la sbyar bas kyang ngo*// yang na me tog sna ma dang*/ shrī khaṇ+ḍa sngo sman ku mā rī/ tsha ba gsum/ lan tshwa/ shog shing*/ de ba da li/ tshangs pa'i shing*/ ya bak+ṣa ra/ rta bon pa/ ar+gha'i shing*/ mkhan pa 'bras bu med pa bshang ba dang*/ khu ba dang*/ khrag de rnams cha mnyam pa dag kyang btags te/ dri chus ril bu byas pa ni rlung rgyu ba ngos kyi sna bug tu blugs pas 'byung po'i gdon gyis zin pa'am/ 'byung po'i rims kyis zin pa'am/ brtan pa'i rims sam/ dug dang*/ lto 'gro ste sbrul gyi dug ni nges par 'joms so// 'dab chags mgon po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs gzhan phan dang bcas pa 'di/ dus kyi 'khor lo pa dol bu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis don grub kyi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la dben gnas bde chen du sbyar ba 'dis sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig shu bhaṃ// ༈ /dus 'khor lugs kyi ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang brtan g.yo'i dug 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra gu ru ḍā ya/ 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum gyi nang nas ye shes khyung khra'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dang bcas pa brtsegs pa'i steng du klu'i rgyal po sog ma med gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan la rang sems k+ṣiṃ kha dog lnga ldan zhu ba las/ rang nyid dus 'khor 'dab chags kyi mgon po rdo rje khyung khra zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mgrin pa nas pus mo'i bar skyes bu'i rnam pa la rkang pa bya'i sder mo can/ dpyi man chad sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ rked pa dang lte ba'i bar chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar me'i rang bzhin dmar po/

mgrin pa nas smin ma'i bar rlung gi rang bzhin nag po/ smin ma yan chad nam mkha'i rang bzhin ljang gu/ spyan gsum nyi ma ltar 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/ gshog pa kha dog sna tshogs pa 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ gnam lcags kyi mchu sder shin tu rno zhing mi bzad pa'i ngar dang ldan pa/ klu rgyal ba ljang gu dang rnam rgyal sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos snyan cha/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar pos lag gdub/ 'jog po dang pad chen ser pos rkang gdub/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar pos ska rags dang mgul rgyan byas pa/ rigs lngas dbur brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis klu rgyal gdug pa can sbrul gyi rnam pa'i sked pa nas bzung zhing mgo bo zhal du gsol ba/ mjug ma zhabs 'og tu mnan nas tsog pu'i 'dug stangs kyi bzhugs pa'o// lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la l̥/ snying gar chu la u/ mgrin par me la ṛ/ dpral bar rlung la i/ gtsug tor du nam mkha' la i/ thugs kar nyi ma la k+ṣiṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhī/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam oṃ ā ī ṝ ū lī pañca dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ dbang bskur rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ thugs ka'i k+ṣiṃ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar gyur pa la dmigs te/ oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ rgyud las bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad bye ba phrag gcig tu bshad do// 'di'i snying gar k+ṣiṃ zhu ba las rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa dang*/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' k+ṣiṃ gi mthar sngags phreng 'god pa rgyud kyi man ngag dam pa'o// gtor ma med kyang chog par bzhed la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su 'bul bar spro na 'og tu bstan pa bzhin byas te 'bul lo// khyung khra la rwa yod pa rgyud kyi lugs su mi 'dod par snang ngo*// 'di'i rjes gnang byed na/

yid mthun gyi gnas su maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad la tshom bu kha dog lnga ldan nam 'bras kyi tshom bus kyang rung bas gcig bkod/ de'i g.yas su gtor ma zlum po rtse mo dbal can mar gyi rgyan can la tsakli yod na btsugs/ dar ljang gu'i gur phub/ de'i mthar chu bzhi dang shar du dri chab/ me tog sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis phyogs ma log par bsham/ nang mchod kyis bsang ba dang mchod pa byin rlabs dkyus bzhin las/ khyad par/ bla ma dang dus 'khor 'dab chags mgon po'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig brjod/ sngar bshad pa bzhin skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar bya/ de nas mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrāḥphaṭa kyis bsang*/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dang bcas pa brtsegs pa'i steng du klu'i rgyal po sog ma med gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan la k+ṣiṃ kha dog lnga ldan zhu ba las/ dus 'khor 'dab chags kyi mgon po sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin bskyed/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyi chu bzhi dang lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ na maḥ zhes nang gis mchod/ gdengs can tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad cing*// 'byung po kun gyi gshed gyur pa// dus kyi 'khor lo gshog sgro can// 'dab chags mgon po la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin gyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥshrī kā la tsakra pa k+ṣiṃ tra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ -i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī baṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā gat+ya sa pa ri wā ra shī gh+raṃ i ba l+yiṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ khā dan+tu/ pi ban+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛb+ta/ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣa ā ba ra ṇa/

gu bhiṃ kurban+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pa gnyis kyis phul/ nang gis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ gdengs can tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad cing*// nas/ phyag 'tshal/ 'khor dang bcas la gtor ma dri// me tog bdug pa sgron ma dang*// ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyis// 'khor bcas de rnams kyang byon la// myur du gtor ma 'di bzung mdzod// gsol bar mdzod cig btung bar mdzod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang dag tshims// sems can kun la zhi ba dang*// rgyas dang bsrung dang skyob pa dang*// sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bsgos mdzod// swā hā/ zhes brjod la gtor ma 'bul/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub kyi mthar/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag dang slob ma rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus phyag byas te gral la 'khod par me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan par bya ba'i chos ni 'dir skabs su babs pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum gyi nang nas brtan g.yo'i dug zhi bar byed pa mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes gnang sgrub par byed pa la/ de yang 'di nyid kyi chos skor nā ro ta pa sogs las brgyud nas dpal sa skya pa la bka' babs pa gser chos man ngag lugs su grags pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud bshad kyi rjes su 'brangs nas kha che zla mgon sogs las brgyud pa'i khyung khra rgyud lugs su grags pa gnyis yod pa las/ da lam phyi ma rgyud kyi bshad srol las byung ba de yin zhing*/

de yang bsdus rgyud las/ mkha' lding grub na gdengs can dbang po rnams dang gdengs can bdag po'i bu rnams mngag gzhug nyid du 'gyur// rab mchog sa yi steng du 'byung po gnod sbyin gdon rnams dag dang mkha' 'gro ma dang ma mo rnams// sngags kyis dgug par rab tu 'gyur te gdon gyi tshogs pa mtha' dag dus kyi sos zin rjod par byed// de phyir sems can don gyi slad du dang por mi rnams kyis ni mkha' lding dbang po bsgrub par bya// zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu'i rjes gnang la slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad nye bar grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ thog mar slob dpon dang dus kyi 'khor lo 'dab chags mgon po tha mi dad pa la rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes bskul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed pa// srid pa'i skyon gyis gos mi 'gyur// phun sum tshogs pa kun gyi gnas// khyod kyi zhabs la skyabs su mchi// zad med 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las// bdag gi skyabs ni gzhan ma mchis// de bas snying rje cher mdzad nas// de ring bdag la sku drin mdzod// lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dus kyi 'khor lo 'dab chags mgon po tha mi dad pa la yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa/ dge ba la yi rang ba/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ dag pa gsum gyi dngos po 'bul ba/ chos 'khor bskor ba/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba/ dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo ba ste bdun rnam dag bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas sdig pa rnam pa mang po bsags pa dag ni bshags par bgyi nas/

bdag bgyid do// slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs drug gi sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni zhes sogs rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang skabs su drangs pa ltar lan gsum/ de rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang las dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi ched du slob dpon dus 'khor 'dab chags kyi mgon po rdo rje khyung khra dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog de gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan khra bun gyis 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dug lnga'i sa bon dang de las bskyed pa'i mtshan rtog ngan pa/ gza' dang klu gnyan gyi kha rlangs las byung ba'i dug gam/ na tsha/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon la sogs pa mi dmigs par sbyangs nas lus shel gong dri ma dang bral ba la nyi zer phog pa lta bu'i 'od kyi phung por gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs su gyur pa las skad cig gis pad+ma zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dang bcas pa brtseg pa'i steng du klu'i rgyal po sog ma med gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan la khyed rang rnams kyi sems kyi dwangs ma k+ṣiṃ kha dog lnga ldan zhu ba las/ khyed rang rnams re re bzhin dus 'khor 'dab chags kyi mgon po nas/ thugs kar nyi ma la k+ṣiṃ/ zhes pa'i bar brjod nas gsal btab/ de lta bu'i sku can du gsal ba'i ngang nas slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

de dag gi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa dus 'khor 'dab chags kyi mgon po rdo rje khyung khra'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ 'bring po mi tshad tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la char chen po babs pa bzhin du byung nas sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes brjod cing spos rol bya/ des rdo rje khyung khra'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang lus kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad gza' skar klu gnyan sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byas nas rdo rje khyung khra'i sku yi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su k+ṣiṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las/ mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyis tshul du sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du k+ṣiṃ gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ pa k+ṣiṃ swā hā/ lan gsum gyi rjes zlos mthar brgya rtsa bzla'o// de ltar bzlas pas dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par byas te/ de'i drin lan du me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ me tog de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas spyi bor gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rdo rje khyung khra'i gsung gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig dam bca' ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rdo rje khyung khra yi dam gyi lhar bzung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dus kyi 'khor lo 'dab chags kyi mgon po yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// des rdo rje khyung khra'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ ngag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad gza' skar klu gnyan sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byas nas rdo rje khyung khra'i gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dpag tu med par spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon k+ṣiṃ sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ slar yang de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas rdo rje khyung khra'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam zhig rgyang gis chad nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa de nyid la dmigs pa gtad pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ rang nyid kyang thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de'ang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur nas rang gzhan gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid las 'das pa stong pa nyid rnam pa thams cad pa dang*/

mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa'i don rgyud la skyes par mos te cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des rdo rje khyung khra'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ yid kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad gza' skar klu gnyan sa bdag gi gnod pa'am/ mtshan rtog ngan pa thams cad zhi bar byas nas rdo rje khyung khra'i thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ spro na gtor ma lhar skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed la/ sngags dang 'don pa bsgyur nas rdo rje shugs kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bka' bsgo byas te gtor ma'i lha slob ma'i spyi bor bstim mo// des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas gnas skabs de dag tu khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs bya/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ mjug tu/ deng nas sogs dkyus bzhin no// rjes mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ tsakli sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu'i ye shes pa rang gi snying gar bsdus la k+ṣaḥ zhes lag gnyis nang bstan gyis gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ ji ltar nyi ma sogs smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang la 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa dang*/ sgyi chu mkhan po byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis zur 'debs mdzad pa'i phyag len rnams gser chos man ngag lugs yin la/ phyis su rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge snang ba ni dus 'khor rgyud lugs kyi phyag len dang mthun pa tsam snang zhing*/ rgyud kyi lugs la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi chings tsam las gzhan mi mdzad cing*/ sgyi chu ba'i yi ge na sku'i rjes gnang la bum dbang sogs dbang bzhi'i tha snyad sbyar 'dug pas/ de 'dra'i chos skad bla med spyi 'gro la ma gtogs dus 'khor gyi lugs su byas na cir yang mi rung ste/

rgyud 'di'i lugs la byis 'jug gi dbang bdun po rnams la yang bum dbang tsam gyi tha snyad sbyor rgyu ma gsungs na rjes gnang la dbang bzhi'i chos skad sbyar ba don med do// de phyir nya dang nyung ma bsre bar mi bya'o// 'di'i las tshogs rnams ni sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas mdzad pa'i yi ger rgyud 'grel las byung ba dang man ngag las byung ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod par gsal ba'i phyir yi ge de nyid las rtogs par bya'o// dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor gyi// brtan g.yo'i dug rnams 'joms pa'i gnyen po'i lha// rdo rje khyung khra'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas// bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun rgyal gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang 'dren mchog bstan pa'i sgron me rje btsun mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi bka' dwangs du blangs nas/ btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin dpal zhwa lu ri phug tu bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
